rules.title: Use the official SDK
rules.text: Use the official Anthropic SDK and read the API key from the environment.

rules.title: Check current model ids
rules.text: Look up current model IDs in the official documentation instead of guessing them; IDs are pinned snapshots, so keep them in configuration.

rules.title: Prompt caching
rules.text: Put stable content (tools, system prompt, reference documents) first, place the cache breakpoint on the last identical block, and verify hits in usage.cache_read_input_tokens.

rules.title: Tool use loops
rules.text: Return a tool_result for every tool_use block in one user message, validate tool inputs, and cap the number of loop iterations.

rules.title: Handle stop reasons
rules.text: Check stop_reason and handle max_tokens, tool_use, pause_turn and refusal explicitly; refusals arrive as normal successful responses.

rules.title: System prompt for role and rules
rules.text: Put role, rules and output format in the system prompt and task data in user messages.
